headline: A federal law renames the VA medical center in West Palm Beach, Florida, after Thomas H. Corey.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in West Palm Beach, Florida, the Thomas H. Corey VA Medical Center. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change the services offered, the staff, or how veterans get care there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the renaming took effect when it was signed.
